description: The plot illustrates the results of "Whisper fine-tunning, type = tiny" by comparing five different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "epoch" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6 with tick marks at intervals of 1. The y-axis is labeled "WER" and uses a linear scale with tick marks ranging from 30 to 70 at intervals of 10. All lines in the plot are grey. The line representing "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" is a solid line with circle markers; it shows a continuous decline across the x-axis, starting at a peak of approximately 68.8 at epoch 0 and dropping to roughly 36.2 at epoch 6. The "tiny AdaLoRA_int8" line is a solid line with square markers, beginning at approximately 59.8 at epoch 0, experiencing a drop to 51.2 at epoch 1, and continuing to decline to end at roughly 32.1 at epoch 6. The "tiny int4" line is a dashed line with circle markers that starts at approximately 68.8 at epoch 0, decreases to 39.4 at epoch 4, remains steady at 39.4 at epoch 5, and ends with a slight increase to roughly 40.1 at epoch 6. The "tiny int8" line is a dashed line with square markers, starting at approximately 59.8 at epoch 0, dropping to 46.8 at epoch 1, and following a gradual downward trend to end at roughly 36.9 at epoch 6. Finally, the "tiny full" line is a dotted line with triangle markers; it remains lower than the other lines throughout the plot, starting at approximately 28.8 at epoch 0, declining to 24.1 at epoch 3, and ending at roughly 23.0 at epoch 6.
